description: Lays out a whole HTML document (with its CSS) as paged print and returns a download link to the PDF, valid 24 hours, and the document's edit link in the ReflowPDF editor (give the person both). Use @page for paper and margins, margin boxes for headers, footers and page numbers; JavaScript does not run. Read read_guide topic "html" before the first document. To change the document later, use update_document with its document_id.

filename.description: The PDF file name, e.g. "invoice-1042.pdf". Default: the document's <title>.

html.description: The whole HTML document: <!doctype html>, <html lang>, a <title>, a <style> in <head> with @page. Self-contained; images and fonts by https URL, data: URI or an upload_image link.

preview.description: A picture (PNG) of page 1 comes with the answer, so you can check the layout, fonts and images before giving the links. Default: true.

name: render_pdf
